top_stories.title: Scientists turn DNA into a memory device that uses 100x less power
top_stories.description: Researchers combined synthetic DNA with a semiconductor to create an ultra-low-power memory device capable of storing and processing information in the same place. The bio-hybrid technology could eventually help make AI systems and next-generation computers far more energy efficient.
